author: National Geographic
description:
What are agencies doing to crack down on illegal operations? Journey along with CBP and HSI agents to fight crime in this To Catch a Smuggler MEGA episode. Featuring three, full episodes:

Smuggled and Muzzled - 0:00
CBP Nogales uncovers cocaine in the bumper of a car crossing from Mexico, and CBP Atlanta stops a woman smuggling underaged puppies from Brazil.

Talibani Treasure Trove - 44:02
HSI busts a ketamine smuggler in Miami, K9s sniff out fentanyl in San Diego and JFK officers uncover ancient gold looted from Afghanistan.

Endangered and Smuggled - 1:28:04
CBP investigates a trend of cocaine concealed in coffee bags, and cracks down on a series of wildlife trafficking crimes.
